name: zz 0.20mm Speed Custom @BBL X2D 0.6 nozzle
description: Personal preset - the 'zz' prefix sorts it last in the preset lists. Fast 0.20 mm process for the X2D 0.6 nozzle, for smoother surfaces than the 0.30 mm profile at roughly the same print time. A 0.62 x 0.20 mm line is 0.124 mm2, so the matching 'zz Generic PLA Fast @BBL X2D 0.6 nozzle' filament ceiling of 36 mm3/s caps the real speed at ~290 mm/s - a higher number than 0.30 mm, but the print is not faster because the extruded volume and the flow ceiling are unchanged. Speeds are set just under that: inner wall and solid/sparse infill 280, outer wall 220, gap fill 270, first layer 80 walls / 150 infill at 1000 mm/s2. Top surface is kept at the stock 150 for finish. Sparse infill is gyroid at the default 15%. Top and bottom shells are pinned to 3 layers (0.6 mm of skin, thinner than the 0.9 mm at 0.30 mm - raise to 4-5 for the same skin thickness). Inherits the 0.30 mm Standard profile with only layer_height and the speed set changed.
